pages.title: Spells on the Road
pages.text: Spell Merchants appear rarely across the Overworld. Recognize their violet robes, speak to them and open Trade.$(br2)Each carries twelve distinct spell scrolls. Stock stays within the merchant's realm, and stronger merchants favor more advanced spells. Prices follow the same values as the System Shop.

pages.title: Buy, Then Comprehend
pages.text: Each offer is a real scroll in the merchant's inventory. Buying removes it; returning or reloading does not refill sold stock. Merchants replenish at the next in-game day and update stock when their realm changes.$(br2)A purchased scroll uses its normal learning process and requirements. It does not immediately teach a spell.

pages.title: Two Trading Paths
pages.text: Recipe Merchants carry alchemy, talisman and forging recipes. Spell Merchants carry spell-learning scrolls. Both share ordinary NPC interaction, real inventory, realm-based stock and daily restocking.$(br2)For creative building or testing, both have dedicated spawn eggs.
